title: Immutable acquisition and document parsing

files.change: Preserve successful legacy extraction; route by media type and capture revisions before parsing.
Bounded fetch, content addressing, SSRF/redirect protection, rights and private-scope enforcement.
HTML/text/PDF/table parser with stable page/span locators; explicit OCR path for scanned pages.
Pin compatible PDF and schema-validation dependencies after fixtures; OCR subprocess installation only if selected and tested.
Persistent revision/blob volume and bounded resource settings; preserve all existing volumes.
Only required parsing runtime dependencies, no browser automation stack by default.

steps: Keep original authorized bytes plus immutable parsed text; preserve filename/media type and all document dates separately.
Use a filesystem-backed BlobStore interface on VPS initially; future object storage adapter without DB identity changes.
Detect scanned PDF; OCR confidence and page coordinates required. OCR uncertainty blocks exact claim verification.
Uploaded documents go through authenticated intake and same pipeline, not an alternate unvalidated import path.
tests: Changed content at same URL creates revision; identical content replay deduplicates.
Network/OCR/parser failure does not blank last good text.
SSRF redirects, private IPs, oversized documents, compression bombs and tenant-crossing citations rejected.
